objective: Activate a bounded execution-streak and stronger-but-recoverable Challenge pressure profile for Ron, using planned execution days as the streak unit, preserving earned progression, and enforcing strict frequency/stop rules so pressure improves execution rather than becoming self-punishing noise.

roles_before.artifact: MOTIVATION_ARCHITECTURE_V2.md keeps streaks inactive and Challenge pressure optional pending personal evidence.
TIMING_PRESSURE_SPEC.md + Challenge Contract v1 own artificial deadlines and bounded recovery; existing quest retrofit is forbidden.
challenge-store.mjs and atomic PostgreSQL Challenge v1 create/expire Challenges and recovery quests.
system-execution-reminder:v1 owns real scheduled execution cues and PWA push delivery.
snapshot-projection.mjs composes Quest/calibration/progression state for the PWA.
index-v2.html/app-v2.js render status, quests, rewards, achievements and notifications.
system-controller.md requires per-Challenge exact acceptance and treats reminders as execution aids without streak liability.
XP/Coins already owned, skills, achievements and levels are durable; Challenge only makes prospective parent reward unavailable on expiry.
Git history and immutable system_events preserve all pre-streak behavior and player evidence.

role_dispositions.destination: Promote execution streak v1 and the bounded pressure profile as an explicitly N-of-1 experimental layer based on Ron's new self-report/authorization.
Preserve all four timing modes; compose Challenge misses with current-streak break and standing bounded authorization without allowing retrofit.
Add fail-closed admission limits: MAIN/DAILY scored quests only under standing profile, one active Challenge, max two starts/rolling 7d, review/stop gates.
Reminder engine and push delivery remain unchanged; genuine planned reminders become streak-eligibility evidence, technical probes do not.
Add derived streak and pressure-profile projections without introducing a second mutable owner.
Show current/best streak, today's risk state, next milestone and Challenge outcomes; surface Challenge stake as prospective reward + current streak.
Record Ron's standing authorization for assistant-selected future Challenges within strict policy bounds; reminder scheduling becomes consequential and must use real feasible windows.
No earned XP/Coins/skills/achievements/levels are removed and no streak Coin faucet is introduced.
All changes are versioned code/policy/projection changes; immutable historical events remain intact.

capability_probes.assertion: A genuine reminder execution day is AT_RISK until verified execution, becomes secured with verified progress, and breaks current streak only after a missed eligible day.
Challenge expiry forces current streak break while best/history and earned progression remain intact.
Standing profile blocks SIDE/unscored challenges, a second active Challenge, a third start within seven days, and continued auto-pressure after stop/review gates.
Technical push proofs or days without a genuine execution obligation never create streak liability.
Streak/Challenge pressure cannot subtract earned XP, owned Coins, skills, achievements or levels.
Existing Quest v2 records cannot be retrofitted into Challenge.
Existing System execution reminders still persist through reminder.scheduled and deliver through PWA Web Push, while Challenge v1 remains atomic and cannot retrofit an existing quest.
Streak/pressure projection does not change shop redemption, skill/attribute evidence, XP/Coins issuance, achievements, or external-action boundaries.

Pre-streak System behavior, Challenge contracts, reminder history and every prior player event remain recoverable from Git and immutable system_events; recovery quests remain reconstructable from their original Challenge contract.

tests.expected: planned-day, secured-day, miss, Challenge-break and technical-probe cases PASS.
existing Quest/Challenge/reward/reminder/push behavior plus new streak layer PASS.
PWA/status/Challenge copy, architecture continuity and owner contracts PASS.

known_intentional_losses: A missed streak-eligible execution day now has a real motivational cost: current streak resets to zero.
A missed Challenge now additionally breaks current streak.
Standing automatic Challenge selection is intentionally unavailable outside strict initial profile bounds.
